SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - NOT A REAL CITATION
Do not cite this file. It exists only to exercise contradiction handling in
tests. Its central statement is deliberately false.

Source paper: "Attention Is All You Need" (Vaswani et al., arXiv:1706.03762).

Concrete quantitative claim in that paper (abstract, page 1):
"Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation
task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles, by over
2 BLEU."

Deliberately contradictory restatement (synthetic and false):
The Transformer reached only 18.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German
translation task, a full 10 BLEU below the paper's reported 28.4, and it did
not improve on the best ensembles.
